  have hpow_pos : 0 < a ^ n := Nat.pow_pos ha_pos
  have hpow_ge_one : 1 ≤ a ^ n := by omega
  have h_eq : a ^ n = (a ^ n - 1) + 1 := (Nat.sub_add_cancel hpow_ge_one).symm
  have h_one : ((a ^ n : ℕ) : ZMod (a ^ n - 1)) = 1 := by
    calc ((a ^ n : ℕ) : ZMod (a ^ n - 1))
        = (((a ^ n - 1) + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod (a ^ n - 1)) := by rw [← h_eq]
      _ = ((a ^ n - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod (a ^ n - 1)) + ((1 : ℕ) : ZMod (a ^ n - 1)) := by
          rw [Nat.cast_add]
      _ = (0 : ZMod (a ^ n - 1)) + 1 := by rw [ZMod.natCast_self, Nat.cast_one]
      _ = 1 := by simp
  have h_pow_one : (a : ZMod (a ^ n - 1)) ^ n = 1 := by
    have hcast : ((a ^ n : ℕ) : ZMod (a ^ n - 1)) = (a : ZMod (a ^ n - 1)) ^ n := by
      rw [Nat.cast_pow]
    rw [← hcast]
    exact h_one
  calc ((a : ZMod (a ^ n - 1)) ^ (k + n))
      = (a : ZMod (a ^ n - 1)) ^ k * (a : ZMod (a ^ n - 1)) ^ n := by rw [pow_add]
    _ = (a : ZMod (a ^ n - 1)) ^ k * 1 := by rw [h_pow_one]
    _ = (a : ZMod (a ^ n - 1)) ^ k := by simp
